messages:
matt: Heads-up — merged PR #1234 that changes the default kernel-selection heuristic (falls back to fp16-pref on lower-latency profiles). It's a default change, no schema/API change. Deploy window tomorrow morning. Do we treat this as a patch or minor bump?
priya: Can you paste the diff / what callers might observe?
matt: Sure — short snippet:
```
- default_kernel: legacy
+ default_kernel: latency_pref
```
matt: Practically: ~5-12% lower latency on most long-context models, but some tiny variance in top-k timing. No output format change.
sylvia: My read: behavior visible to users (latency), but not breaking. By strict semver, behavior change in defaults that can affect user-observed perf -> minor.
ops-liaison: Ops concern: customers that pin to major.minor (not patch) might unexpectedly get different perf if they don't pin patch. We need clear release notes + a canary and an opt-out flag.
priya: Agree on canary. Question for the group: do we consider this "bugfix" or "behavioral improvement"? If bugfix -> patch, if opt-in/behavioral -> minor.
matt: It's intentional improvement, not a bugfix. We also changed the default that could affect latency-sensitive users. Leaning minor.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary -> 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z, rollout->gradual on 2026-03-22 window unless rollback triggered. Canary target: 5% of requests for top-tier models.
sylvia: Let's add a runtime flag "--kernel-default=legacy|latency_pref" so customers can opt out without pinning. That lets us ship minor while preserving customer control.
ops-liaison: +1. Also: add a short migration note: "If you rely on tight latency SLAs, enable legacy until you validate." Put this in release notes and console banner.
priya: For tagging: current release is 2.14.3. If we go minor bump: tag 2.15.0 and create a 2.14.4 for any follow-up fixes. If we (unexpectedly) decide patch: 2.14.4.
matt: Consensus call: bump minor to 2.15.0, publish canary, include opt-out flag, and add explicit release-note section "Performance default change (opt-out)".
ops-liaison: I'll draft the release note blurb and console banner. cc @sylvia for review.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployed. Monitoring hooks: latency_p99, error_rate, kernel_fallback_rate. Auto-rollback if latency_p99 increases >15% over baseline for 10m.
sylvia: I'll monitor; if anything odd, we rollback immediately.
matt: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: PR for flag + doc, release notes draft, tagging to 2.15.0 after canary stable. :thumbsup:
